headline: Strong Revenue Momentum, with Margins Set for H2 Recovery

highlights: (BEML) CMP: ₹1990 Target ₹ 2765 (39%) Target Period: 12 months November 9, 2026 Strong Revenue Momentum, with Margins Set for H2 Recovery… About the stock : A BEML is a diversified engineering PSU operating across Rail & Metro, Defence & Aerospace and Mining & Construction.
Q 2F Y2 7 performance : BEML reported revenue of ₹1,192 crore in Q2FY27, up 42.0% YoY, supported by improved execution.
However, gross margin declined 770 bps YoY to 44.1% (vs. 51.8%), as higher cost of revenues weighed on profitability.
EBITDA increased to ₹79 crore from ₹73 crore (+8.5% YoY), but EBITDA margin contracted to 6.6% from 8.7%.

Management is targeting FY27 order inflows of ₹20,000 crore, with Rail & Metro expected to contribute around 50%.
Management is targeting an export order book of US$200 million by FY27-end, with exports expected to contribute 6–7% of FY27 revenue.
